name: Central Carolina Plastics Inc
about:
Central Carolina Products, Inc. operates from Burlington, North Carolina, where it was founded in 1993 as a minority-owned, family-operated business. The privately held company has grown to occupy two facilities — a new plant built in 2003 and a second acquired in 2008 — serving customers worldwide from its Piedmont Triad location.

The company specializes in custom injection molding of thermoplastics using 61 microprocessor-controlled presses ranging from 40 to 1,650 tons. Its capabilities extend to scientific molding (RJG/Kistler), insert and over molding, hot oil molding, and sequential valve gate control, complemented by robotic extraction, custom end-of-arm tooling, and automated material handling. Value-added services include assembly, decorative coating, design and development support, tool construction and repair, and laboratory validation testing.

Primary customers are automotive OEMs and tier suppliers — General Motors, Lear Corporation, IAC, and Tower Components appear in testimonials — along with industrial manufacturers such as Stanley Black & Decker and Xylem. The firm is registered to ISO 9001:2015 and NSF/ANSI 61, and follows AIAG quality standards.

Central Carolina Products positions itself as a single-source provider, combining molding, finishing, and assembly under one roof in a climate-controlled environment. The company emphasizes engineering collaboration, process capability (CPK) monitoring, and APQP/PPAP compliance as differentiators rooted in its founding goal to deliver dimensionally critical and cosmetically perfect parts.
